quest.name: The Dead Star Over Hearthwatch
quest.offer_dialogue: The bell rang at noon without a hand touching it. I need someone brave enough to ask why.
quest.active_dialogue: Begin at the keep, then confirm the omen through the temple district, the arcane observatory, and the river manifests.
quest.completed_dialogue: You have gathered enough signs to prove the Marches face a coordinated planar threat.
quest.description: Investigate the omen above Hearthwatch by gathering evidence from the central keep and the six surrounding districts.
quest.completion_text: You have gathered enough signs to prove the Marches face a coordinated planar threat.

quest.name: Hearthwatch: Six Roads Around the Keep
quest.offer_dialogue: A town is not a map marker. Walk it. Learn who eats, prays, trades, schemes, studies, and unloads the boats.
quest.active_dialogue: Visit each district and bring back proof that the dead-star omen touched more than the keep bell.
quest.completed_dialogue: Velia grants you a civic writ and the right to question witnesses across Hearthwatch.
quest.description: Tour the six civic districts surrounding the keep, collect civic testimony, and establish Hearthwatch Crossing as a living hub rather than a single square.
quest.completion_text: Velia grants you a civic writ and the right to question witnesses across Hearthwatch.

quest.name: Keep Readiness Drill
quest.offer_dialogue: Before you leave our walls, prove you can see how those walls are held.
quest.active_dialogue: Check the muster yard and report whether the road lanterns, stores, and patrol rotations are ready.
quest.completed_dialogue: Sera marks you as a reliable field aide for the Marchwardens.
quest.description: Inspect the keep muster yard, lantern racks, and civic defenses before the player is trusted with road work.
quest.completion_text: Sera marks you as a reliable field aide for the Marchwardens.

quest.name: The Doorway Lesson
quest.offer_dialogue: Most monsters enter through doors, roads, or bad decisions. We train for all three.
quest.active_dialogue: Complete the drill and learn how Hearthwatch’s soldiers hold choke points during raids.
quest.completed_dialogue: Vell admits you might survive the roads if you continue listening.
quest.description: Complete a martial tutorial framed as a Marchwarden defensive drill in the keep muster yard.
quest.completion_text: Vell admits you might survive the roads if you continue listening.

quest.name: What the Commons Heard
quest.offer_dialogue: The fancy folk saw an omen. The common folk heard what happened after.
quest.active_dialogue: Speak to residents around the commons, inn, and bellfounder lane to separate rumor from witness evidence.
quest.completed_dialogue: Brindle adds your notes to the official district ledger.
quest.description: Interview common residents, inn guests, and workshop families to collect grounded testimony about the dead star.
quest.completion_text: Brindle adds your notes to the official district ledger.

quest.name: Noble Masks and Missing Steel
quest.offer_dialogue: We require discretion. Naturally, that means everyone will know by dusk.
quest.active_dialogue: Search the noble terrace and Auric House for signs of a missing ancestral blade.
quest.completed_dialogue: Isolde admits the noble houses remember more of the old war than they publicly claim.
quest.description: Investigate noble houses hiding ancestral knowledge about the first Astral Crown sealing.
quest.completion_text: Isolde admits the noble houses remember more of the old war than they publicly claim.

quest.name: False Weights, True Panic
quest.offer_dialogue: Fear makes bad markets. Bad markets make dead towns.
quest.active_dialogue: Review the Guildhall ledger and question traders in the market arcade.
quest.completed_dialogue: Senna identifies forged contracts routing supplies away from the road lanterns.
quest.description: Trace suspicious contracts through the market district to reveal who is profiting from fear.
quest.completion_text: Senna identifies forged contracts routing supplies away from the road lanterns.

quest.name: The Missing Manifest
quest.offer_dialogue: Someone thinks the river forgets. I need you to disappoint them.
quest.active_dialogue: Inspect the river gate, quay, and customs vault for altered cargo records.
quest.completed_dialogue: Keel restores the manifest enough to expose a hidden Crownless shipment.
quest.description: Recover a scraped warehouse manifest fragment and connect hidden cargo to the Crownless Cabal.
quest.completion_text: Keel restores the manifest enough to expose a hidden Crownless shipment.

quest.name: Marks Beneath the Chalk
quest.offer_dialogue: I do not mind contraband nearly as much as cursed contraband.
quest.active_dialogue: Inspect marked crates at the quay and report which warehouse doors should be sealed.
quest.completed_dialogue: Naia’s crews lock down the dangerous goods and keep the river trade moving.
quest.description: Help the quay crews identify suspicious crates without letting smugglers endanger dockhands.
quest.completion_text: Naia’s crews lock down the dangerous goods and keep the river trade moving.

quest.name: The Lamps That Do Not Bow
quest.offer_dialogue: Fear first attacks the people with nowhere else to sleep. Help me keep the lamps lit.
quest.active_dialogue: Check the temple row, mercy cloister, and oath brazier sanctum for failing wards.
quest.completed_dialogue: Annel blesses the roads and confirms the old ward-stone predates the keep.
quest.description: Stabilize temple lamps and charity routes shaken by the dead-star omen.
quest.completion_text: Annel blesses the roads and confirms the old ward-stone predates the keep.

quest.name: Blue Fire Under a Dead Star
quest.offer_dialogue: The lanterns are not malfunctioning. They are answering something.
quest.active_dialogue: Stabilize the lanternhouse, spellwright lane, glyph archive, and observatory readings.
quest.completed_dialogue: Caldus concedes the dead star points toward the outer relics and the Astral Crown seal.
quest.description: Calibrate the Concordium lantern array to prove the dead star is interacting with the ancient relic network.
quest.completion_text: Caldus concedes the dead star points toward the outer relics and the Astral Crown seal.

quest.name: Names of the Dead
quest.offer_dialogue: A person erased from record can be killed twice. I object to both murders.
quest.active_dialogue: Search the glyph archive and recover the scratched-out names from the old war registers.
quest.completed_dialogue: Miravel restores the names and gives the Silver Concord proof of a centuries-long Cabal operation.
quest.description: Restore erased names in the glyph archive and expose Cabal memory-magic connected to older wars.
quest.completion_text: Miravel restores the names and gives the Silver Concord proof of a centuries-long Cabal operation.

quest.name: Lanterns Along Applebough Mile
quest.offer_dialogue: If the lanterns fail before Applewallow, the old road becomes a hunting lane. Light them and listen to the locals.
quest.active_dialogue: Check the road lantern furrow north of the ferry and clear whatever stuffed the lamps with grave straw.
quest.completed_dialogue: The road shines again, and Captain Orran admits the Freeholds were right to demand help before relics.
quest.description: Secure the first road into Greenbarrow by restoring the lanterns on Applebough Mile and defeating a Hollow Scarecrow.
quest.completion_text: The restored lanterns make Applewallow reachable after dusk.

quest.name: Applewallow: Customs of the Small Door
quest.offer_dialogue: Tall road, small doors. Learn the rules before you duck through them, friend.
quest.active_dialogue: Follow the Applebough Mile to the south stile, then present yourself at Applewallow Village Green.
quest.completed_dialogue: Pip decides you are not hopeless and teaches you the first Freehold rule: no one eats alone during danger.
quest.description: Meet Pip Thornbarrow on Applebough Mile, learn the customs of the Barrow Freeholds, and reach Applewallow without insulting every gate, bowl, and auntie in sight.
quest.completion_text: Pip’s introduction gives you enough local trust to speak with the Applewallow elders.

quest.name: The Freehold Before the Relic
quest.offer_dialogue: Outsiders always ask about relics first. I ask about root cellars, widows, fences, and winter.
quest.active_dialogue: Read the village board, visit the grain co-op, and prove that Applewallow’s living people matter more than old treasure.
quest.completed_dialogue: Merrian names you guest-friend of the Freehold and allows talk of the old seed cache beneath the barrows.
quest.description: Help Elder Merrian stabilize Applewallow before asking the Barrow Freeholds to surrender knowledge of their ancestral relic.
quest.completion_text: Applewallow agrees to help the wider Marches once its immediate needs are honored.

quest.name: No Grain for the Unsharing
quest.offer_dialogue: Grain theft is not hunger. Hunger leaves apologies. This left accounting marks.
quest.active_dialogue: Search the common root cellars and the stolen root cellar in The Dire Burrows for the missing tally.
quest.completed_dialogue: The tally proves the theft was designed to divide households against each other.
quest.description: Recover proof that someone is stealing communal grain to break the Freeholds’ shared-store system.
quest.completion_text: Hob restores the grain ledger and keeps Applewallow from turning fear inward.

quest.name: Geese Know Where the Ground Lies
quest.offer_dialogue: Laugh at the geese after they save you, not before.
quest.active_dialogue: Clear burrow gnawers from the Cloverdown Sheepfolds and learn where the tunnel line is moving.
quest.completed_dialogue: The sheep calm down, the geese remain judgmental, and the militia marks a safer patrol route.
quest.description: Assist the Freehold militia in the sheepfolds, where guard geese have located fresh burrow activity before the shepherds could.
quest.completion_text: The Freehold militia secures the pasture line and points you toward the old willow crossing.

quest.name: Names Under Clover
quest.offer_dialogue: A name is a chair at the table. I will not let that thing steal chairs from our dead.
quest.active_dialogue: Take a rubbing from the barrow rise or ancestor crypt and return with proof of the erased names.
quest.completed_dialogue: Benna reads the names aloud, and the crypt grows warmer by several heartbeats.
quest.description: Restore ancestor names scratched from the clover barrows before the village dead become tools of the thing beneath the fields.
quest.completion_text: The restored names weaken the miser-wights guarding the older tunnels.

quest.name: Tracks to The Dire Burrows
quest.offer_dialogue: Tracks are just gossip written by feet. These tracks are screaming.
quest.active_dialogue: Clear the North Furrows, reach the old willow crossing, and find the entrance to The Dire Burrows.
quest.completed_dialogue: Tressa confirms the creature below is organized, not merely hungry.
quest.description: Follow Tressa Goodfurrow’s field signs from the north furrows to The Dire Burrows mouth.
quest.completion_text: The scout’s route opens the dungeon approach beneath the old willow.

quest.name: The Loam Remembers the Sharing Path
quest.offer_dialogue: The maze was never meant to stop guests. It was meant to stop owners.
quest.active_dialogue: In the Grave-Loam Maze, follow the path east, north, west, north to reach the First Seed Cache.
quest.completed_dialogue: Ysella’s hearthstone wakes, revealing that the old relic is a seed of communal plenty.
quest.description: Cross the Grave-Loam Maze by following the Freehold symbols and reach the hidden seed cache.
quest.completion_text: The First Seed Cache opens to you because you followed the signs of shared bread, hand, bowl, and seed.

quest.name: The Shared Seed Against the Unsharing Maw
quest.offer_dialogue: He wants every family alone, every pantry locked, every favor priced. That is why he must not leave these tunnels.
quest.active_dialogue: Push through the Fallow Shrine and Starved Hall, defeat Fallowmaw in the hoard-throne, and recover the Shared Seed relic.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Unsharing Maw collapses into dust and spilled grain. Applewallow’s relic will join the wider Marches by oath, not theft.
quest.description: Defeat Fallowmaw, the Unsharing Lord, and claim the Shared Seed of Greenbarrow without letting its power become another hoard.
quest.completion_text: The Greenbarrow relic is secured, and the northern stile opens toward Whispering Briar.

quest.name: The Lost Pie Tin
quest.offer_dialogue: It is not just a pie tin. It is my adventuring shield. Also Aunt Mara will notice.
quest.active_dialogue: Search the Bone Pantry in The Dire Burrows and bring back the lucky tin before the adults learn how far Kite wandered.
quest.completed_dialogue: Kite accepts the tin with solemn gratitude and immediately promises to stop adventuring for at least one full afternoon.
quest.description: Find Kite Underhill’s lucky pie tin, which vanished near the bone pantry after a dare went badly wrong.
quest.completion_text: A child’s missing keepsake is returned, giving Applewallow one small normal victory amid larger fears.

quest.name: A Scholar’s Measure of Mud
quest.offer_dialogue: The mud here is historically significant. Also it tried to bite my boot.
quest.active_dialogue: Bring Dorrick a grave-loam sample from the barrows or mushroom run.
quest.completed_dialogue: Dorrick learns the difference between research permission and being chased by angry aunties.
quest.description: Help a visiting scholar collect a clean grave-loam sample without trampling sacred barrows or insulting local farmers.
quest.completion_text: The independent survey produces useful lore without violating Freehold grave customs.

quest.name: The Honeybell Warning Spiral
quest.offer_dialogue: Bees are polite prophets. They only sting when we ignore the sermon.
quest.active_dialogue: Clear rotroot blight from the bee-yards and bring back wax for warding candles.
quest.completed_dialogue: The hives settle, and Lina renders wax for lantern charms against the burrows.
quest.description: Investigate the bee-yards where the Honeybell hives are forming warning spirals over blighted roots.
quest.completion_text: The bee-yards return to work, and Applewallow gains better ward candles for the coming night.

quest.name: Quartermaster’s Law
quest.offer_dialogue: Bring me proof you can prepare before you bleed.
quest.active_dialogue: A hero with no supplies is just a future cautionary tale.
quest.completed_dialogue: Bren signs off on your campaign kit and opens better stock.
quest.description: Gather supplies and prove the player understands preparation loops: food, antidote, tools, and equipment upgrades.
quest.completion_text: Bren signs off on your campaign kit and opens better stock.

quest.name: A Star With No Name
quest.offer_dialogue: I saw a crown without a head and a star without warmth. You are already in its shadow.
quest.active_dialogue: When the Nightscale Lantern is claimed, return to the Wyrmheart Cavern and find the crown-shaped wound hidden there.
quest.completed_dialogue: The final constellation is no longer prediction. The Citadel gate is open, and every road behind you has become preparation.
quest.description: Follow Seer Liora’s warning to the Nightscale-lit gate that opens from Wyrmheart Cavern to the Astral Crown Citadel.
quest.completion_text: The Astral Crown Citadel has revealed its entrance through the Wyrmheart Cavern. What remains beyond it is a point of no return.

quest.name: Dawnhammer Hills: The Free Road
quest.offer_dialogue: Before you chase raiders, understand the road they are bleeding.
quest.active_dialogue: Travel from the Dawnhammer Roadhead through the Sun-Iron Way and report to Vandarom Guildhall.
quest.completed_dialogue: Now you have seen both ends of the trade road: ore in the west, work in the east, fear between them.
quest.description: Learn the independent compact of Dawnhammer Hills and reach Vandarom, the manufacturing city.
quest.completion_text: You understand that Dawnhammer's crisis is not simple banditry; it is an attack on free labor and neutral trade.

quest.name: Bhon Falduhr: Missing Shifts
quest.offer_dialogue: My miners are not numbers. Find where the numbers start lying.
quest.active_dialogue: Audit Bhon Falduhr's counting office and assay hall to prove when the missing shifts disappear.
quest.completed_dialogue: The ledger confirms it. The raiders know our private schedule.
quest.description: Help Bhon Falduhr identify how the Crownless Cabal is timing raids against the mine workforce.
quest.completion_text: Foreman Dorrak arms the crews and shares the mine's sealed old gallery route into the Quiet Tunnels.

quest.name: The Broken Wheel Evidence
quest.offer_dialogue: The broken wheels point somewhere. Help me read the wreckage before more wagons join it.
quest.active_dialogue: Search Broken Wagon Hollow, defeat the raiders there, and locate the abandoned mouth of the Quiet Tunnels.
quest.completed_dialogue: The wrecks were dragged toward the old mine. That is where the stolen ore is going.
quest.description: Track the supply raids from the caravan road to the old mine mouth.
quest.completion_text: The route into the Quiet Tunnels is confirmed.

quest.name: Main Story: The Dawn-Forge Keystone
quest.offer_dialogue: The keystone remembers free hands. Veskar would make it remember chains.
quest.active_dialogue: Defeat Master Veskar Blackvein, recover the Dawn-Forge Keystone, and secure proof of the Cabal weapon program.
quest.completed_dialogue: The lost shift stands taller. The keystone joins your relic chain by consent, not seizure.
quest.description: Complete The Quiet Tunnels, defeat the necromancer enslaving dwarf remains, and claim Dawnhammer's relic for the Astral Crown ward-chain.
quest.completion_text: Dawnhammer Hills remains independent, and the northern road opens toward Sunken Crown Marsh.

quest.name: Assay the Theft
quest.offer_dialogue: I need a true sample from the face before I accuse anyone with a counterfeit.
quest.active_dialogue: Collect a legitimate sun-iron sample from Bhon Falduhr's active seam.
quest.completed_dialogue: Good. This sample will make every false buyer sweat through their beard.
quest.description: Help the assay hall distinguish real shipments from stolen or counterfeit lots.
quest.completion_text: Nalda can now identify Cabal-stolen sun-iron by impurity pattern.

quest.name: Relight the Switchback Signals
quest.offer_dialogue: Get my signal mirror speaking again and I can move convoys before dusk.
quest.active_dialogue: Inspect and align the Switchback Watch signal mirror.
quest.completed_dialogue: The mirror is talking to Vandarom again. That saves lives before blades leave scabbards.
quest.description: Repair road signals so caravans can respond to raids in real time.
quest.completion_text: The Sun-Iron Way regains its warning network.

quest.name: Caravans Under Hammerfall
quest.offer_dialogue: I can replace wheels. I cannot replace trust. Bring me proof of who knew our route.
quest.active_dialogue: Clear the Red Scree ambush site and recover the raider coded bill.
quest.completed_dialogue: This bill is not bandit work. This is procurement for a war machine.
quest.description: Defend the caravan route and uncover the Cabal's supply raid records.
quest.completion_text: Karvi reorganizes convoys around verified escorts and rotating schedules.

quest.name: Wounds That Do Not Bleed
quest.offer_dialogue: Something cold is practicing on my patients. Bring down one of the things causing it.
quest.active_dialogue: Defeat a sun-iron ghoul in or near the Quiet Tunnels and return with evidence of its residue.
quest.completed_dialogue: Necromancy mixed with sun-iron filings. That explains the cold burns.
quest.description: Help the mine medic understand injuries caused by undead raiders.
quest.completion_text: Bera prepares better treatment for attacked miners and road guards.

quest.name: The True Sun-Iron Sample
quest.offer_dialogue: Fetch a clean ingot, and I will show you what honest Dawnhammer work feels like in the hand.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover a sun-iron ingot from the active face or reliquary.
quest.completed_dialogue: Clean grain, clean heat, clean maker. Take the axe. It will not lie for you.
quest.description: Acquire verified sun-iron to expose counterfeit Cabal forge marks.
quest.completion_text: The sample helps Vandarom isolate stolen metal from lawful trade.

quest.name: The Forced Side Gate
quest.offer_dialogue: Ride the deep lift and find what forced the side gate. If it was from below, we have a bigger problem than rails.
quest.active_dialogue: Descend the Bhon Falduhr lift and inspect the forced side gate into the old workings.
quest.completed_dialogue: Below, then. Of course below. The mountain has terrible taste in surprises.
quest.description: Investigate sabotage connecting Bhon Falduhr to the Quiet Tunnels.
quest.completion_text: The mine crew braces the lift and opens a controlled route for rescue work.

quest.name: Honor the Lost Shift
quest.offer_dialogue: A tally stone is missing. One miner's name is still trapped in the dark.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover the lost shift tally from Bhon Falduhr and return it to Ulfra.
quest.completed_dialogue: There. The dead can be dead now, not missing.
quest.description: Restore a lost miner's tally to Dawnhammer's remembrance rolls.
quest.completion_text: The miners share hidden stories about the old sealed gallery.

quest.name: Follow the Buyer Trail
quest.offer_dialogue: Find the writ that does not belong. Every stolen wagon still had paperwork.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover a stolen caravan writ from the raider hide-scrape or route debris.
quest.completed_dialogue: That buyer never existed. The Cabal used a ghost company to order a war.
quest.description: Trace the false purchasing network behind the sun-iron raids.
quest.completion_text: Orris blocks the false buyer identity from Dawnhammer trade ledgers.

quest.name: The Stew Line Rumor
quest.offer_dialogue: Stir the pot, listen to the line, and tell me which traveler lies with an empty bowl.
quest.active_dialogue: Spend time at the convoy cookfires and compare rumors from the stranded crews.
quest.completed_dialogue: There it is. The same hooded buyer ate here three nights before each raid.
quest.description: Use waystation gossip to identify the raiders' informant pattern.
quest.completion_text: The cookfires become a living intelligence post for caravan crews.

quest.name: Vandarom: No Chains in the Forge
quest.offer_dialogue: Bring me proof they meant to enslave us, and the guild vote becomes a war vote.
quest.active_dialogue: Find and destroy the chain pens inside The Quiet Tunnels, then bring back a broken slave chain.
quest.completed_dialogue: This chain was forged from our stolen metal. The vote is unanimous: Dawnhammer resists.
quest.description: Prove the Cabal intends to enslave dwarven manufacturers, not merely steal sun-iron.
quest.completion_text: Vandarom commits guards, supplies, and legal witness to the campaign against the Cabal.

quest.name: Audit the Foreign Buyers
quest.offer_dialogue: Neutrality survives only if every contract can stand in daylight.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover the black sigil-bone from the Vandarom Rune Press.
quest.completed_dialogue: This is not a buyer seal. It is a domination mark disguised as procurement.
quest.description: Help protect Dawnhammer's open trade from Cabal infiltration.
quest.completion_text: Foreign buyer contracts are frozen until their maker marks can be verified.

quest.name: False Maker Marks
quest.offer_dialogue: Someone is putting our city stamp on tyranny. Bring me the plan and I will put my hammer through it.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover the Cabal weapon schematic from the Quiet Tunnels forge-plan room.
quest.completed_dialogue: Siege rivets, chain hooks, collar hinges. They wanted our reputation as well as our metal.
quest.description: Expose the Cabal's plan to counterfeit Vandarom maker marks on weapons and slave equipment.
quest.completion_text: Rogan issues a new verification rune to protect Dawnhammer exports.

quest.name: Manifest for a Living Convoy
quest.offer_dialogue: Help me build a convoy manifest that cannot be turned against us.
quest.active_dialogue: Review the caravan yard and compare the Vandarom gate manifests.
quest.completed_dialogue: Good. Different order, different bells, different guard rotations. Let the raiders chase yesterday.
quest.description: Assist Vandarom's caravan yard in changing supply movements after the raids.
quest.completion_text: Future caravans move under randomized manifests and stronger guard rotations.

quest.name: Clean the Rune Press
quest.offer_dialogue: The press has been made to lie. Remove the bone, and I can teach it truth again.
quest.active_dialogue: Inspect the Vandarom Rune Press and retrieve the black sigil-bone.
quest.completed_dialogue: The press is clean. The next mark it stamps will know its own name.
quest.description: Repair Vandarom's maker-mark system after Cabal sabotage.
quest.completion_text: Torva restores the city stamp and adds an anti-Cabal verification cut.

quest.name: Open Anvil Grievances
quest.offer_dialogue: Before the guilds vote, hear what the workers fear when officers leave the room.
quest.active_dialogue: Listen to grievances at the Open Anvil Taproom.
quest.completed_dialogue: There. Fear named aloud becomes a thing we can strike.
quest.description: Gather worker concerns and keep Vandarom's response grounded in its people.
quest.completion_text: The guildhall debate accounts for laborers, not only owners and captains.

quest.name: Break the Chain Pens
quest.offer_dialogue: The pens first. Kill guards after if you like, but break the pens first.
quest.active_dialogue: Destroy the unfinished chain pens and defeat the Cabal taskmaster guarding them.
quest.completed_dialogue: Good. Now if they take us, they will have to improvise. I dislike making tyranny convenient.
quest.description: Sabotage the Cabal's planned enslavement chamber inside the Quiet Tunnels.
quest.completion_text: Mara escapes to warn Vandarom about the full production plan.

quest.name: Stop the Bone-Rail Tram
quest.offer_dialogue: If a tram moves without a living crew, remove the part that lets it pretend.
quest.active_dialogue: Disable the bone-rail tram and recover its brake pin.
quest.completed_dialogue: Ugly bit of work, that pin. Useful, though. I will melt it somewhere respectful.
quest.description: Shut down the necromantic tram used to move stolen ore through the mine.
quest.completion_text: The Cabal loses its quickest ore-hauling route.

quest.name: The Side-Cutters' Caches
quest.offer_dialogue: The old side-cutters hid supplies off the safe path. Find one cache and prove the map still speaks.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover the Quiet Tunnel Map from the side-cutter cache.
quest.completed_dialogue: The side-cuts are still there. Good. The main route was never the only route.
quest.description: Reward patient exploration through the mine's off-route caches.
quest.completion_text: The map reveals how the Quiet Tunnels were worked before the Cabal corrupted them.

quest.name: Whispering Briar: Guest-Right Under Thorns
quest.offer_dialogue: Outsiders die here mostly from manners, not monsters. I can help with one of those.
quest.active_dialogue: Pass the Root-Toll, follow the Moonmote Causeway, and reach the Living Gate of Onfadell.
quest.completed_dialogue: You reached Onfadell as a recognized guest instead of a wandering trespasser.
quest.description: Earn safe passage from the Root-Toll Hollow to Onfadell by observing Thorn Court etiquette.
quest.completion_text: The Root-Toll accepts your intention, and Onfadell’s gate opens under wary guest-right.

quest.name: Thorn Court: The Toll That Takes No Coin
quest.offer_dialogue: The gate does not want your money. It wants to know whether you will cost us more than you carry.
quest.active_dialogue: Inspect the Living Gate faces, the Moonmote Lanterns, and the Market Bargain Pole to learn the city’s entry customs.
quest.completed_dialogue: The gate records you as a guest bound by reciprocal conduct.
quest.description: Satisfy the Living Gate by proving you understand the Court’s law of hospitality and debt.
quest.completion_text: The Living Gate grants formal passage into Onfadell and marks you with a limited Thorn Court writ.

quest.name: Thorn Court: The White-Thorn Audience
quest.offer_dialogue: You ask for our relics and our roads. First prove you know what our city is losing.
quest.active_dialogue: Gather testimony from the Verdant Archive, Vowtree Grove, and Glassroot Residences before returning to the Seat of the Thorn Court.
quest.completed_dialogue: You have forced the Court to admit the dead-star crisis is not merely a mortal panic.
quest.description: Gain the Thorn Court’s guarded support by proving the dead star threatens Onfadell as much as the mortal Marches.
quest.completion_text: The Archduchess permits investigation of the Lost Orrery and the Nameless Oracle’s trail.

quest.name: Thorn Court: Broken Ribbons at Vowtree Grove
quest.offer_dialogue: A broken vow is a weapon in the wrong hands. We currently have an armory.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover Vowtree Ribbons and defeat Petal-Masked Duelists who have taken the Oracle’s revenge as fashion.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Vowtree quiets, and the accusations narrow from collective guilt to named crimes.
quest.description: Repair the old bargain markers being twisted by the Oracle into accusations against all Fey folk.
quest.completion_text: The Vowtree Grove is stabilized, reducing panic in Onfadell.

quest.name: Thorn Court: Names Under Leaves
quest.offer_dialogue: The Ford is taking names faster than I can carry warnings. I am fast. This is bad.
quest.active_dialogue: Search the Name-Taken Ford and Blank Milestones, defeat Name-Eaten Pilgrims, and recover a Name-Shard.
quest.completed_dialogue: Several stolen names return to their owners, and the Ford becomes safer for travelers.
quest.description: Recover stolen name-shards before the Oracle uses them to curse innocent Fey families.
quest.completion_text: The first edge of the Oracle’s curse is blunted.

quest.name: Main Story: The Lost Orrery of Onfadell
quest.offer_dialogue: The Orrery was sealed because it embarrassed rulers. That makes it useful.
quest.active_dialogue: Open the Overgrown Portico, reach the Axis Hall, and recover the Moonlit Orrery Lens.
quest.completed_dialogue: The lost mechanism wakes enough to show that the Oracle’s grotto lies on the same ward-line as the Astral Crown.
quest.description: Enter the Lost Orrery and determine how its celestial mechanism connects the dead star to the Astral Crown ward-chain.
quest.completion_text: The Lost Orrery reveals the route from Onfadell to the Grotto of the Nameless Oracle.

quest.name: Main Story: Rebuild the Wounded Star
quest.offer_dialogue: The machine is not broken. It is sulking after centuries of correct warnings.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover an Orrery Cog from the Gear-Spirits and carry it to the Broken Planetarium projection.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Wounded Star projection names the Grotto as the next active relic site.
quest.description: Restore the broken planetarium projection so the Thorn Court can no longer deny the dead-star threat.
quest.completion_text: The Orrery projection is restored enough to advance the main story route.

quest.name: Thorn Court: Road to the Nameless Grotto
quest.offer_dialogue: The Oracle has reasons. Reasons are not licenses. Help me preserve the distinction.
quest.active_dialogue: Study the Blank Milestones, survive the Briar-Mouth Silence, and enter the Veilpool Antechamber.
quest.completed_dialogue: You have found the Oracle’s route and proved her vengeance is spreading beyond the guilty.
quest.description: Trace the Oracle’s curse from Onfadell through the Name-Taken Ford to the Grotto entrance.
quest.completion_text: The path into the Grotto of the Nameless Oracle is confirmed.

quest.name: Onfadell Side Quest: Hearth of Many Seasons
quest.offer_dialogue: A city that cannot share a hearth will not survive a curse. Also, the soup is suffering.
quest.active_dialogue: Gather a Singing Leaf and Briar-Mere Lily, then inspect the Hearth of Many Seasons.
quest.completed_dialogue: The hearth burns evenly again, and Onfadell’s residents stop blaming one another for every cold draft.
quest.description: Help Granny Elmoria restore the seasonal hearth that keeps Onfadell’s mortal and Fey residents sharing one neighborhood.
quest.completion_text: The seasonal hearth is restored, improving civilian morale in Onfadell.

quest.name: Independent: Moonbees in the Mere
quest.offer_dialogue: My bees are unionized, enchanted, and currently furious. I need help, preferably from someone without pollen allergies.
quest.active_dialogue: Clear Thornbound Hounds near the Briar Mere and collect Moonmote Ichor to calm the moonbees.
quest.completed_dialogue: The moonbees settle, and Orren can keep supplying charm-honey to both sides of the border.
quest.description: Help a halfling beekeeper rescue moonbees that pollinate small defensive charms for both Applewallow and Onfadell.
quest.completion_text: Moonbee hives are restored, strengthening ties between Greenbarrow and Onfadell.

quest.name: Independent: A Familiar Smell of Trouble
quest.offer_dialogue: My oven has legs now. That is not the problem. The problem is it has opinions.
quest.active_dialogue: Search the Briar Market and Glassroot Residences for signs of the runaway familiar.
quest.completed_dialogue: The oven-familiar is coaxed home with flattery, and the cakes stop predicting embarrassing deaths.
quest.description: Find Vessa Candlecap’s runaway oven-familiar before it bakes cursed sweetroot cakes for half the market.
quest.completion_text: The market returns to normal, or at least Onfadell’s version of normal.

quest.name: Onfadell Side Quest: The Ninth Song
quest.offer_dialogue: Eight songs praise kings. The ninth accuses them. Naturally, it went missing.
quest.active_dialogue: Collect an Echo Reed and Memory Droplet from the Grotto’s early chambers, then return to Ilex.
quest.completed_dialogue: Ilex sings the ninth song, restoring mercy to a story Onfadell preferred to keep ornamental.
quest.description: Recover the lost ninth song that remembers who the Nameless Oracle was before the Court erased her identity.
quest.completion_text: The ninth song gives the city a way to mourn without surrendering to vengeance.

quest.name: Main Story: The Name That Became Revenge
quest.offer_dialogue: She was wronged. Do not let anyone use that truth to excuse what she is doing now.
quest.active_dialogue: Pass the Three Springs, gather proof of truth, grief, and debt, and defeat the Nameless Oracle at the Pool of All Stolen Names.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Oracle’s curse breaks, the stolen names begin returning, and the Crownroot Thorn Sigil joins the ward-chain leading toward the Astral Crown.
quest.description: Confront the Nameless Oracle, stop her revenge against the Fey folk, and claim the Crownroot Thorn Sigil for the Marches’ relic chain.
quest.completion_text: The Whispering Briar relic is secured, and the northern route opens toward Dawnhammer Hills.

quest.name: Reed Law Before Road Law
quest.offer_dialogue: You can walk in like a tax collector or enter like someone who enjoys keeping both legs. I recommend the second path.
quest.active_dialogue: Reach the Reed-Blind Watch and speak with the gate watchers before pushing toward Hawga Daar.
quest.completed_dialogue: Tebo teaches you the safe greeting signs and which causeway planks mean turn back.
quest.description: Learn the first rules of entering Sunken Crown Marsh without insulting Hawga Daar or stepping into a marked brood channel.
quest.completion_text: Tebo teaches you the safe greeting signs and which causeway planks mean turn back.

quest.name: The Outsider Who Listens
quest.offer_dialogue: Speak less. Watch more. If your hand finds your weapon while I talk, the marsh will hear about it.
quest.active_dialogue: Stand at the outer palings, visit the trial pool, and return without forcing the gate.
quest.completed_dialogue: Thraax admits that patience is rare among outsiders and permits you to petition Ssharketh.
quest.description: Before any proving hunt, listen to Hawga Daar’s warnings and demonstrate restraint at the closed gate.
quest.completion_text: Thraax admits that patience is rare among outsiders and permits you to petition Ssharketh.

quest.name: Prove Under Black Water
quest.offer_dialogue: Bring back what was taken from the broodwater. If you return treasure instead, you return nothing.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover Brood-Reed Shells from the hatchling reed-nest or Blackjaw Den, then return to Ssharketh at the outer palings.
quest.completed_dialogue: Ssharketh grants you a Hawga Daar Oath-Scale. The village proper opens, but its trust remains something to maintain.
quest.description: Earn the clan leader’s trust by recovering brood-reed shells from danger and proving the player values the living village over the drowned kingdom’s relics.
quest.completion_text: Ssharketh grants you a Hawga Daar Oath-Scale. The village proper opens, but its trust remains something to maintain.

quest.name: No Steps in Broodwater
quest.offer_dialogue: Small lives are not small duties. Clear the leeches before they find soft shell.
quest.active_dialogue: Defeat the mire leech swarms threatening the hatchling reeds and bring back proof the nest is safe.
quest.completed_dialogue: Issra allows the broodhouse kitchens to feed you and shares details about the old keep’s forbidden lower doors.
quest.description: Defend the broodhouse channels from parasites and learn why Hawga Daar restricts movement through warm nesting water.
quest.completion_text: Issra allows the broodhouse kitchens to feed you and shares details about the old keep’s forbidden lower doors.

quest.name: Blood in the Reeds
quest.offer_dialogue: The crocodile eats what splashes. Do not splash. Kill it anyway.
quest.active_dialogue: Track and defeat the Blackwater Crocodile near the Trial Pool or hunter camp, then bring back a fang.
quest.completed_dialogue: Vhaak ties the fang to a reed cord and names you less useless than most warmbloods.
quest.description: Help Hawga Daar hunters cull the largest blackwater predator and prove you can solve danger without turning on the clan.
quest.completion_text: Vhaak ties the fang to a reed cord and names you less useless than most warmbloods.

quest.name: Mud Is Memory
quest.offer_dialogue: Find a stone that remembers before our grandmothers. Do not clean it too much. Mud is part of memory.
quest.active_dialogue: Bring Old-Scale Korr a Lost King Tablet from the drowned cause-stones or story circle.
quest.completed_dialogue: Korr reads the Draconic overmarks and confirms that Hawga Daar was named for a missing monarch, not founded by one.
quest.description: Recover a Lost King tablet and help Korr reconcile Hawga Daar oral memory with the drowned kingdom’s surviving stone records.
quest.completion_text: Korr reads the Draconic overmarks and confirms that Hawga Daar was named for a missing monarch, not founded by one.

quest.name: The Blackwater Lotus
quest.offer_dialogue: Cut only the flowers with silver undersides. Take the others and I will know by how the marsh coughs.
quest.active_dialogue: Collect Blackwater Lotus from the lotus isle and return it to Mender Ssaali.
quest.completed_dialogue: Ssaali prepares medicine for hatchlings and admits that some outsiders can learn not to steal the roots.
quest.description: Gather blackwater lotus for fever medicine without stripping protected blooms used by Hawga Daar healers.
quest.completion_text: Ssaali prepares medicine for hatchlings and admits that some outsiders can learn not to steal the roots.

quest.name: Scholar Below the Waterline
quest.offer_dialogue: I only need a rubbing. Not a claim, not an excavation charter, not a heroic theft. A rubbing.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover a Crown Mosaic Rubbing from the Sunken Vaults records or mosaic hall.
quest.completed_dialogue: Velis identifies the dead-star geometry and warns that the Astral Crown was designed as a divided ward, not a royal ornament.
quest.description: Help Velis document evidence that the Sunken Crown relic is one band of the larger Astral Crown without handing ownership of the site to outsiders.
quest.completion_text: Velis identifies the dead-star geometry and warns that the Astral Crown was designed as a divided ward, not a royal ornament.

quest.name: The Name-Short Manifest
quest.offer_dialogue: One name short. One banner wet. One pole stroke from harbor.
quest.active_dialogue: Search the ghost barge hold and recover the Waterlogged Royal Banner.
quest.completed_dialogue: The poleman adds the missing name to his manifest and lets the barge drift out of the living channel.
quest.description: Resolve a ghost barge manifest by recovering its waterlogged banner and learning which soldier was never properly recorded dead.
quest.completion_text: The poleman adds the missing name to his manifest and lets the barge drift out of the living channel.

quest.name: Repair the Low Pumps
quest.offer_dialogue: Here. Crank for old king machine. Turn slowly unless you want the vault to spit you out like a fishbone.
quest.active_dialogue: Carry Drokh’s Vault Pump Crank to the upper pump house and activate the cistern mechanism.
quest.completed_dialogue: The upper vault drains enough to reveal the armory, cells, and the next sluice mechanism.
quest.description: Use Hawga Daar pumpcraft to drain parts of the Sunken Vaults, opening paths that are otherwise inaccessible under black water.
quest.completion_text: The upper vault drains enough to reveal the armory, cells, and the next sluice mechanism.

quest.name: The Crown Beneath Hawga Daar
quest.offer_dialogue: The band below is not our ruler, but it weighs on our throats. Drain what must be drained. Leave what should stay buried.
quest.active_dialogue: Descend into the Sunken Vaults, study the Crown Mosaic Hall, and unlock the deeper drowned treasury.
quest.completed_dialogue: Nema recognizes the relic’s pulse as one piece of the larger Astral Crown ward and directs you toward the final confrontation.
quest.description: Enter The Sunken Vaults beneath the old keep and determine why a relic tied to the Astral Crown is poisoning Hawga Daar’s water and memories.
quest.completion_text: Nema recognizes the relic’s pulse as one piece of the larger Astral Crown ward and directs you toward the final confrontation.

quest.name: What the Water Hid
quest.offer_dialogue: Upper water lies. Lower water remembers. Find the key and make the deep rooms speak.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover the Sluice Gate Key and operate the lower pump chamber.
quest.completed_dialogue: The lower vault drains, revealing the sunken treasury and the Crown-Drowned Wight’s route.
quest.description: Find the Sluice Gate Key and use it to drain the lower vault, exposing what the lost kingdom tried to keep submerged.
quest.completion_text: The lower vault drains, revealing the sunken treasury and the Crown-Drowned Wight’s route.

quest.name: Captain of a Kingdom That Drowned
quest.offer_dialogue: If any piece of me still knows honor, let it ask you this: stop the captain, not the oath. The oath was made to protect. He made it hunger.
quest.active_dialogue: Defeat Captain Ildran Veyr in the Drowned Oathhall and recover the Drowned Band of the Astral Crown.
quest.completed_dialogue: The wight captain falls, and the Drowned Band of the Astral Crown is freed from the lost kingdom’s final command.
quest.description: Defeat Captain Ildran Veyr, the undead knight-captain whose oath has turned the Astral Crown band into a weapon against Hawga Daar and the living Marches.
quest.completion_text: The wight captain falls, and the Drowned Band of the Astral Crown is freed from the lost kingdom’s final command.

quest.name: Glasswind: The Buried Titan Highway
quest.offer_dialogue: Roads look simple on maps. Out here they breathe, vanish, and collect debts. Walk the first miles and tell me what the titan-stones are whispering.
quest.active_dialogue: Follow the Buried Titan Highway east to the mirage well, check the stone ribs, and report anything that looks like magic pretending to be weather.
quest.completed_dialogue: Tavik marks your route on blue vellum and grants you safe-parley rights with the three nomad camps.
quest.description: Survey the western Buried Titan Highway and establish the Glasswind Expanse as a living road zone rather than an empty desert crossing.
quest.completion_text: Tavik marks your route on blue vellum and grants you safe-parley rights with the three nomad camps.

quest.name: Blue Veil: Three Camps, Three Ambitions
quest.offer_dialogue: The Blue Veil is not one tent. Meet the Ajuna, Dhanor, and Shakni before you claim to know us.
quest.active_dialogue: Speak with the three head representatives and learn why each believes their research should lead the whole faction.
quest.completed_dialogue: Yasira accepts that you have listened before asking for relics. That is rarer than bravery.
quest.description: Meet the Ajuna, Dhanor, and Shakni representatives and understand the political competition inside the Blue Veil Caravans.
quest.completion_text: Yasira accepts that you have listened before asking for relics. That is rarer than bravery.

quest.name: Ajuna Research: The Fourth Wind Formula
quest.offer_dialogue: The tower mirror is late by four breaths. Bring me the true angle and I will show you how to step through a mirage without insulting it.
quest.active_dialogue: Reach the Azure Mirage Tower and record the Ajuna mirror angle from its upper deck.
quest.completed_dialogue: Saffi copies the angle into a formula scroll and lets you keep the field version.
quest.description: Help the Ajuna refine a mirage movement formula by measuring the first tower alignment.
quest.completion_text: Saffi copies the angle into a formula scroll and lets you keep the field version.

quest.name: Dhanor Research: Crates Taken in Sunlight
quest.offer_dialogue: A robbery at noon is either stupidity or excellent optics. I despise both when my lenses are involved.
quest.active_dialogue: Investigate the saltflat raid site and defeat the raiders interfering with Dhanor supply caravans.
quest.completed_dialogue: Borun recovers enough lens stock to keep the tower work honest and grudgingly admits your timing was useful.
quest.description: Track supply raids against Dhanor research caravans and recover the damaged lens crates.
quest.completion_text: Borun recovers enough lens stock to keep the tower work honest and grudgingly admits your timing was useful.

quest.name: Shakni Research: Proof Without Sound
quest.offer_dialogue: Noise is not truth. The Ivory Tower will give you a measurement only if you stop trying to command it.
quest.active_dialogue: Reach the Ivory Mirage Tower and collect the silent mirror angle without breaking the Shakni hush-wards.
quest.completed_dialogue: Naleth knots a silence charm around your wrist and smiles at the fact that you did not speak over the answer.
quest.description: Assist Shakni research by collecting the third tower alignment under ritual silence.
quest.completion_text: Naleth knots a silence charm around your wrist and smiles at the fact that you did not speak over the answer.

quest.name: Independent: The Ledger of Missing Wheels
quest.offer_dialogue: Everyone tracks stolen gold. I track missing wheels. Wheels tell better lies.
quest.active_dialogue: Check caravan axles, wheel marks, and titan-stone rubbings to prove where the raiders left the highway.
quest.completed_dialogue: Merek updates the ledger and quietly removes three innocent guards from suspicion.
quest.description: Use practical caravan accounting to separate real raider evidence from camp rumor.
quest.completion_text: Merek updates the ledger and quietly removes three innocent guards from suspicion.

quest.name: Independent: The Glassflute That Forgot Its Song
quest.offer_dialogue: A song can get lost in this desert. Mine wandered into a sinkhole and came back as bad weather.
quest.active_dialogue: Search the veilglass sink for Ishun’s missing glassflute resonance.
quest.completed_dialogue: The recovered tone quiets a line of quarrels in the Shakni camp before they become politics.
quest.description: Recover a lost Shakni resonance from a dangerous veilglass sink.
quest.completion_text: The recovered tone quiets a line of quarrels in the Shakni camp before they become politics.

quest.name: Independent: Tea for Rival Scholars
quest.offer_dialogue: Bring tea to three scholars who refuse to share a table. If they throw cups instead of knives, we call that progress.
quest.active_dialogue: Carry tea between rival camp scholars and listen for the research gossip they reveal when irritated.
quest.completed_dialogue: Omes pays you in coin, tea, and several alarming rumors about the Invisible Dungeon.
quest.description: A social side quest showing the ordinary camp life and academic rivalries of the Blue Veil.
quest.completion_text: Omes pays you in coin, tea, and several alarming rumors about the Invisible Dungeon.

quest.name: Main Story: Align the Three Mirage Mirrors
quest.offer_dialogue: The dead star has bent the old mirror network. Align all three towers and the invisible door may remember that doors are supposed to open.
quest.active_dialogue: Align the Azure, Ember, and Ivory Mirage Towers, then bring the readings together at the barrier basin.
quest.completed_dialogue: Thirana locks the three readings into a Triune Mirage Index capable of dropping the Invisible Dungeon’s outer barrier.
quest.description: Collect and reconcile the three tower alignments needed to deactivate the magical barrier around the Invisible Dungeon.
quest.completion_text: Thirana locks the three readings into a Triune Mirage Index capable of dropping the Invisible Dungeon’s outer barrier.

quest.name: Dhanor Secret: The Sandglass Door
quest.offer_dialogue: If you find a password door in my tower, it is definitely not mine. If you find the spellbook behind it, bring it here before pretending you cannot read.
quest.active_dialogue: Find the password clue in the Ember Mirage Tower, open the Sandglass Door, and recover the hidden spellbook.
quest.completed_dialogue: Borun studies the spellbook, copies one safe margin note, and leaves the dangerous parts in your keeping.
quest.description: Open an Emerald Keep-style password door in the Ember Tower to earn a special spellbook reward.
quest.completion_text: Borun studies the spellbook, copies one safe margin note, and leaves the dangerous parts in your keeping.

quest.name: Main Story: The Barrier That Was Not There
quest.offer_dialogue: Use the index at the barrier. Do not trust your eyes after it opens. Trust your shadow, then mistrust that too.
quest.active_dialogue: Use the Triune Mirage Index at the barrier basin and enter the Invisible Dungeon.
quest.completed_dialogue: You cross a threshold that was absent from every map except the dead star’s reflection.
quest.description: Deactivate the magical barrier and gain entrance to the Invisible Dungeon.
quest.completion_text: You cross a threshold that was absent from every map except the dead star’s reflection.

quest.name: Crownless Cabal: Collars for Unseen Labor
quest.offer_dialogue: I helped carry the collars. I thought they were for beasts. They were sized for people who cast spells.
quest.active_dialogue: Defeat the Null-Mage Binders and destroy the anti-will collars meant to enslave Blue Veil researchers.
quest.completed_dialogue: Edran sobs with relief when you return. Cowardice did not save him, but confession might save someone else.
quest.description: Expose a Crownless Cabal plan to use the Invisible Dungeon as a hidden forced-labor spellworks.
quest.completion_text: Edran sobs with relief when you return. Cowardice did not save him, but confession might save someone else.

quest.name: Invisible Dungeon: Map of Wrong Shadows
quest.offer_dialogue: A place no one can see still has edges. Bring me one edge and I will believe the old stories half as much as I fear them.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover the Invisible Map Fragment from the dungeon’s shadow-cartography chamber.
quest.completed_dialogue: Yasira overlays the fragment with Ajuna starcloth and finds a route that should not exist.
quest.description: Recover cartographic proof of the Invisible Dungeon’s shifting architecture.
quest.completion_text: Yasira overlays the fragment with Ajuna starcloth and finds a route that should not exist.

quest.name: Main Story: The Glass Wyrm and the Crown Lens
quest.offer_dialogue: The wyrm swallowed the lens because secrets taste like spellfire. Kill it, or the Astral Crown will lose another ward to appetite.
quest.active_dialogue: Defeat the Glass Wyrm and recover the Mirage Shard of the Astral Crown.
quest.completed_dialogue: The blue-glass witness names the shard as one of the Astral Crown’s concealment lenses and points the road onward toward the coast.
quest.description: Slay the Glass Wyrm in the Invisible Dungeon and recover the Glasswind relic tied to the Astral Crown’s ward system.
quest.completion_text: The blue-glass witness names the shard as one of the Astral Crown’s concealment lenses and points the road onward toward the coast.

quest.name: Duskfall Coast: Bells Before Gulls
quest.offer_dialogue: Travelers who follow gulls get robbed. Travelers who follow bells live long enough to complain about taxes.
quest.active_dialogue: Follow the salt road through the Tidebound checkpoint and reach Terrecester Wharf.
quest.completed_dialogue: You enter Terrecester knowing enough of Tidebound law not to look like easy prey.
quest.description: Reach Terrecester Wharf by the coast road and learn the local bells, laws, and pirate warnings before entering the harbor war.
quest.completion_text: You enter Terrecester knowing enough of Tidebound law not to look like easy prey.

quest.name: Duskfall Coast: The Harbor Must Eat
quest.offer_dialogue: Pirates want our walls hungry before they want them broken. Bring me proof the supply raids can be stopped.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover salt cod, warrants, or raider proof from the southern road and market districts.
quest.completed_dialogue: Terrecester’s kitchens and wall crews can hold another week.
quest.description: Help the harbormaster keep Terrecester functioning under siege by restoring supply confidence and recovering stolen stores.
quest.completion_text: Terrecester’s kitchens and wall crews can hold another week.

quest.name: Duskfall Coast: Flags in the Reeds
quest.offer_dialogue: Kobolds raid like sparks, humans aim them like a fire. Find the flags that connect them.
quest.active_dialogue: Search Gullwatch, the reed rafts, or the hidden kelp beach for pirate signal flags.
quest.completed_dialogue: The pirate fleet loses its shore signals, and the bombardment line grows blind.
quest.description: Track the signal network coordinating kobold rafts with human privateers.
quest.completion_text: The pirate fleet loses its shore signals, and the bombardment line grows blind.

quest.name: Main Story: The Tidecrown Pearl
quest.offer_dialogue: The pearl does not belong to the sea forever. It belongs to the one who reaches it without becoming a pirate in finer boots.
quest.active_dialogue: Defeat or satisfy Eshdru, recover the Tidecrown Pearl, and carry Duskfall’s relic onward.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Tidecrown Pearl accepts your keeping, and the path toward the storm country opens.
quest.description: Claim the Tidecrown Pearl from Eshdru after surviving the Buried Labyrinth’s test of patience, wit, and restraint.
quest.completion_text: The Tidecrown Pearl accepts your keeping, and the path toward the storm country opens.

quest.name: Ferry Rule: The Closed Hearthwatch Window
quest.offer_dialogue: Do not glare at me. The Tidebound League closed that window, not Ollis Reed.
quest.active_dialogue: Inspect the closed coastal ticket window at Hearthwatch Ferry Landing.
quest.completed_dialogue: You understand the ferry rule: Terrecester sells the ticket, Hearthwatch only honors it.
quest.description: Confirm that the Hearthwatch coastal ticket office is closed and that fast travel to Terrecester requires a ticket purchased on the far shore.
quest.completion_text: You understand the ferry rule: Terrecester sells the ticket, Hearthwatch only honors it.

quest.name: Ferries Do Not Sail on Promises
quest.offer_dialogue: Heroes are still passengers. Passengers need tickets.
quest.active_dialogue: Obtain the Terrecester ferry ticket from the open ticket office and use it at the Tidebound pier.
quest.completed_dialogue: Your ticket is stamped and the Tidebound ferry route is now legitimate.
quest.description: Purchase or present a stamped Terrecester ferry ticket so the fast route to Hearthwatch can be used without breaking story progression.
quest.completion_text: Your ticket is stamped and the Tidebound ferry route is now legitimate.

quest.name: Checkpoint Quest: No Fire on the Salt Road
quest.offer_dialogue: They keep hitting wagons with pitch-seal and food. That is siege work, not bandit work.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover raider proof from the burnt caravan pullout or smuggler ditches.
quest.completed_dialogue: The checkpoint can reopen wagon traffic under guard.
quest.description: Clear the raiders harassing supply wagons between Glasswind and Terrecester.
quest.completion_text: The checkpoint can reopen wagon traffic under guard.

quest.name: Gate Quest: Hold the South Gate
quest.offer_dialogue: My gate does not fall to paperwork with knives. Show me which paperwork has knives.
quest.active_dialogue: Bring a forged warrant or defeated spotter proof to the south gate.
quest.completed_dialogue: The south gate watch tightens its inspections and stops a planned breach.
quest.description: Help defend the south gate from infiltrators using false signals and privateer warrants.
quest.completion_text: The south gate watch tightens its inspections and stops a planned breach.

quest.name: League Quest: Break the Bombardment Line
quest.offer_dialogue: We can patch stone. We cannot patch morale forever. Break their fire line.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover bombardment fuses and defeat raiders along the outer breakwater.
quest.completed_dialogue: The bombardment weakens, giving Terrecester’s defenders room to repair.
quest.description: Disrupt the pirate bombardment threatening Terrecester’s outer breakwater.
quest.completion_text: The bombardment weakens, giving Terrecester’s defenders room to repair.

quest.name: League Quest: The False Flags
quest.offer_dialogue: Pirates are thieves. Privateers are thieves with grammar. I want their grammar.
quest.active_dialogue: Bring pirate signal flags from the reed rafts or Glendes beach.
quest.completed_dialogue: The League identifies the fleet’s command pattern and prepares counter-signals.
quest.description: Expose the mixed kobold-human privateer fleet by recovering their coordinated flag codes.
quest.completion_text: The League identifies the fleet’s command pattern and prepares counter-signals.

quest.name: League Quest: The League Feeds Its Own
quest.offer_dialogue: Control without food is theater. Bring me what keeps roofs, hulls, and stomachs whole.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover salt cod or pitch-seal from the market, drydock, or raider caches.
quest.completed_dialogue: The council releases emergency stores and public panic recedes.
quest.description: Keep Terrecester’s civic order intact by securing food, pitch-seal, and dock stores during the siege.
quest.completion_text: The council releases emergency stores and public panic recedes.

quest.name: Island Quest: Passage to Glendes
quest.offer_dialogue: I can sail through teeth if I know which teeth are rocks and which are pirates. Bring me a chart.
quest.active_dialogue: Acquire the Glendes Island Tide Chart from Terrecester’s chart room or Tidepier.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Glendes route is marked and the skiff can reach the island ruin.
quest.description: Prepare a safe crossing to the Glendes Islands where the Buried Labyrinth waits offshore.
quest.completion_text: The Glendes route is marked and the skiff can reach the island ruin.

quest.name: Temple Quest: Lamps for the Returning Tide
quest.offer_dialogue: A dark lamp invites the wrong dead home. Bring oil and a steady hand.
quest.active_dialogue: Find sealed reef-lamp oil and relight the shrine west of the boardwalk.
quest.completed_dialogue: The shrine lamp burns blue, and the harbor fog retreats.
quest.description: Relight the Reefmist Shrine so the fog withdraws from Terrecester’s harbor mouth.
quest.completion_text: The shrine lamp burns blue, and the harbor fog retreats.

quest.name: Shipwright Quest: Ropes Cut at Midnight
quest.offer_dialogue: Ropes do not cut themselves unless they are ashamed. Mine are not ashamed.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover a cut rope sample from the ropewalk and identify the saboteur’s knot.
quest.completed_dialogue: The shipwrights reinforce their lines and catch the next saboteur by the hands.
quest.description: Find evidence of sabotage in Shipwright Lane before another patrol cutter is crippled.
quest.completion_text: The shipwrights reinforce their lines and catch the next saboteur by the hands.

quest.name: Magehouse Quest: Tidal Ink and Ship Wards
quest.offer_dialogue: The ward equations keep trying to drown themselves. I require better ink and fewer explosions.
quest.active_dialogue: Bring pitch-seal or labyrinth rubbing samples to restore a ship ward.
quest.completed_dialogue: Hellis stabilizes a new tide-glass ward for the League patrol cutters.
quest.description: Help the dock mage repair tide-glass ship wards damaged by pirate sabotage.
quest.completion_text: Hellis stabilizes a new tide-glass ward for the League patrol cutters.

quest.name: Independent: The Widow’s Net
quest.offer_dialogue: My net did not tear on rock. Someone cut it, and someone will answer.
quest.active_dialogue: Find the cut rope sample or net charm around the net yard and ropewalk.
quest.completed_dialogue: Elane identifies the knot as a privateer signal and warns the fishing fleet.
quest.description: Recover evidence from a cut fishing net that reveals shore spies are marking civilian boats.
quest.completion_text: Elane identifies the knot as a privateer signal and warns the fishing fleet.

quest.name: Independent: Salt Cod for the Wall
quest.offer_dialogue: An empty bowl makes a coward of anyone. Bring the cod back.
quest.active_dialogue: Find salt cod in the market stores or raider caches.
quest.completed_dialogue: The kitchens feed the wall crews, and Mother Sennit sends you away with stew.
quest.description: Recover salt cod crates so Terrecester’s defenders and refugee kitchens can keep working.
quest.completion_text: The kitchens feed the wall crews, and Mother Sennit sends you away with stew.

quest.name: Customs Quest: False Privateer Bonds
quest.offer_dialogue: Bad ink has killed more sailors than bad weather. Bring me the warrant.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover a forged privateer warrant from raiders or the customs house evidence shelf.
quest.completed_dialogue: Jem proves the bonds false and strips the pirates of legal cover.
quest.description: Expose forged privateer warrants being used to cloak piracy as legal sea-war.
quest.completion_text: Jem proves the bonds false and strips the pirates of legal cover.

quest.name: Blue Veil Side Quest: Missing Saltbroker Crates
quest.offer_dialogue: Desert contracts and sea contracts agree on one thing: missing crates are expensive.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover pitch-seal or a saltpearl cache from smuggler routes.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Blue Veil broker confirms pirates are targeting magical cargo, not just food.
quest.description: Help the Blue Veil broker track missing crates between Glasswind caravans and the Duskfall harbor.
quest.completion_text: The Blue Veil broker confirms pirates are targeting magical cargo, not just food.

quest.name: Dungeon Quest: The Buried Labyrinth
quest.offer_dialogue: I can explain the labyrinth, provided we do not stand inside it while it disagrees.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover a wall rubbing and reach the threshold beyond the Saltblind Maze.
quest.completed_dialogue: Vannis confirms the maze tests intent as much as direction.
quest.description: Map the Buried Labyrinth’s serpent path and survive its traps long enough to reach the threshold of worthiness.
quest.completion_text: Vannis confirms the maze tests intent as much as direction.

quest.name: Independent: A Kobold’s Surrender
quest.offer_dialogue: Rikrik no boom. Rikrik tell where boom-captains keep flags. You not throw Rikrik into sea, yes?
quest.active_dialogue: Recover a kobold oar token or pirate flags and decide whether Rikrik deserves shore-law protection.
quest.completed_dialogue: Rikrik is placed under League protection and the pirate chain of command becomes clearer.
quest.description: Hear the confession of a kobold defector and recover proof that pirate captains are using kobold crews as expendable fuses.
quest.completion_text: Rikrik is placed under League protection and the pirate chain of command becomes clearer.

quest.name: Storms Over the Switchback
quest.offer_dialogue: The first climb tells you whether the mountain intends to bargain or bury you. Walk with care.
quest.active_dialogue: Follow the switchback toward Shepherd’s Eyrie and learn why the storm season has turned violent.
quest.completed_dialogue: Rellan marks the first safe camps and admits the storm is being driven by hands, not weather.
quest.description: Enter Thundervale Peaks, read the Stormbreak route, and survive the first climb toward Shepherd’s Eyrie.
quest.completion_text: The foothill route is secured and the High Eyrie path is open.

quest.name: The Shepherds of High Eyrie
quest.offer_dialogue: My people are not scenery beneath giant feet. Help us keep our bells, bridges, and children alive.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover evidence from the pastures and stabilize the settlement’s storm warnings.
quest.completed_dialogue: Matriarch Ysbet grants you High Eyrie trust and a mantle suited for the upper climb.
quest.description: Help the mortal settlement survive before asking them to risk their giant treaties and storm-season stores.
quest.completion_text: Shepherd’s Eyrie stands with the wider Marches because you treated it as a home, not a checkpoint.

quest.name: Bells Before Lightning
quest.offer_dialogue: Something cut the warning bells. Goats do not respect mysteries. Neither should you.
quest.active_dialogue: Search the pasture line and bring back the broken hooks as proof.
quest.completed_dialogue: Mina reties the bells and points you toward the raiders near Thunderfall Bridge.
quest.description: Repair the bell line in the sky-goat pastures and learn that the herd panic was engineered by Cabal sappers.
quest.completion_text: The warning bells ring again, giving the Eyrie time to shelter before sudden strikes.

quest.name: Thunderfall Bridge Sabotage
quest.offer_dialogue: The bridge wants to survive. The Cabal wants it to kill travelers while pretending to be weather.
quest.active_dialogue: Reach the open span, defeat the sappers, and ground the bridge chain.
quest.completed_dialogue: Ilyra confirms the sabotage points toward old giant storm-runes and the lower hold.
quest.description: Track Cabal sappers across Thunderfall Bridge and repair the grounding chain before the bridge becomes a lightning trap.
quest.completion_text: Thunderfall Bridge can be crossed without turning every metal buckle into a death sentence.

quest.name: Giant Steps, Small Feet
quest.offer_dialogue: The dead star’s pattern continues here, but the peaks speak in weather rather than ink.
quest.active_dialogue: Copy the overlook record and inspect the broken storm-rune terrace.
quest.completed_dialogue: The envoy identifies the Hollow Thunderforge as the source of the corrupted storm cycle.
quest.description: Study the Giant-Step Causeway and recover archive evidence proving the storm giants are victims of manipulation, not the source of the crisis.
quest.completion_text: The player can approach Vhal Torunn with evidence rather than accusation.

quest.name: Audience Beneath Thunder
quest.offer_dialogue: Words are vapor. Bring proof that survives thunder.
quest.active_dialogue: Reach the audience chamber after investigating the broken storm-rune and bridge sabotage.
quest.completed_dialogue: Maelthra withdraws her objection. The giants will allow a mortal attempt to repair what small hands helped reveal.
quest.description: Earn the right to speak before the storm giants by presenting proof that the Cabal, not the mortal settlements, corrupted the mountain weather.
quest.completion_text: The storm giants accept the player as a judged ally rather than an intruder.

quest.name: Three Runes for the Ascent
quest.offer_dialogue: The lift is not broken. It is refusing bad authority. Bring me the parts that prove better intent.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover the cloud-smith coil from the raider camp and bring it to Orvanth’s workbench.
quest.completed_dialogue: Orvanth forges the Charged Stormlift Sigil and teaches the first principle of Cloudstep Ascent.
quest.description: Recover stolen stormlift components so Orvanth can rebuild the ascent key needed for the Stormlift.
quest.completion_text: The Stormlift can now be awakened by the player at the base platform.

quest.name: The Sealed Stormlift
quest.offer_dialogue: The lift rises for proof, not impatience. Show it the sigil and keep your hands inside the storm.
quest.active_dialogue: Activate the Stormlift console at the base platform.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Stormlift carries you through the thunderline into the cloud-hung upper hold.
quest.description: Use the Charged Stormlift Sigil to awaken the Stormlift and reach the upper hold of Vhal Torunn.
quest.completion_text: Upper Vhal Torunn becomes accessible through valid up/down travel.

quest.name: The Tempest Archive Index
quest.offer_dialogue: The giants remember in rain. Bring back the page that remembers the dead star.
quest.active_dialogue: Reach the upper archive and recover the relevant weather record.
quest.completed_dialogue: The archive confirms the Aegis is a Thundervale relic first, but one that can stabilize the broader ward-chain.
quest.description: Search the upper Tempest Archive for records linking the Thunderheart Aegis, the Hollow Thunderforge, and the wider relic road.
quest.completion_text: The player understands why the relic should be carried as protection rather than conquest.

quest.name: The Shrine of the First Thunder
quest.offer_dialogue: A frightened climber hears only noise. A steady one hears warning.
quest.active_dialogue: Visit the ledge shrine and carry its blessing through the next storm.
quest.completed_dialogue: Elaun blesses your climb and gives you thunder balm for the upper roads.
quest.description: Restore a cliff shrine and recover a prayer against fear before the ascent to Vhal Torunn.
quest.completion_text: The shrine’s prayer steadies the mortal settlement during the unnatural storm.

quest.name: Feathers, Not Reins
quest.offer_dialogue: A griffon is not a ladder with wings. Go learn the difference before someone loses a hand.
quest.active_dialogue: Reach the High-Wind Roost and recover a shed feather without harming the treaty flock.
quest.completed_dialogue: Rusk accepts the feather as proof you can respect a powerful neighbor without owning it.
quest.description: Investigate the high roost without treating the griffons as mounts to be claimed.
quest.completion_text: The griffon treaty remains intact, adding local depth without replacing the Stormlift ascent.

quest.name: The Hollow Thunderforge
quest.offer_dialogue: The forge was made to calm storms. It now speaks like a corpse. Go inside and learn who taught it that language.
quest.active_dialogue: Reach the forge gate, read the warning slab, and survive the first entry vault.
quest.completed_dialogue: Jorund hears the forge’s true wound through your report and names Vael Tormak as the likely binder.
quest.description: Enter the Hollow Thunderforge and identify how the Cabal is turning a weather engine into a necromantic weapon.
quest.completion_text: The dungeon’s purpose becomes clear: repair the storm engine before claiming the relic.

quest.name: Ground the Corpse-Lightning
quest.offer_dialogue: A weaponized storm is a failed shelter. Ground it before you fight at the heart.
quest.active_dialogue: Use a sky-iron grounding spike in the conduit and clear the Cabal clamps.
quest.completed_dialogue: The forge current turns cleaner, weakening Vael’s control over the bound dead.
quest.description: Repair the reversed grounding conduit so the forge can bleed hostile lightning into stone instead of bones.
quest.completion_text: The path to freeing the storm spirits is opened.

quest.name: Release the Bound Storm
quest.offer_dialogue: No storm should be chained into hatred. Free them if you can survive their gratitude.
quest.active_dialogue: Break the storm-spirit seals after repairing the grounding conduit.
quest.completed_dialogue: The spirits flee upward as clean rain, and the forge stops feeding Vael as strongly.
quest.description: Free the storm spirits trapped inside the Hollow Thunderforge after the grounding conduit is repaired.
quest.completion_text: The dungeon responds to repair and mercy, not only combat.

quest.name: The Corpse-Lightning Binder
quest.offer_dialogue: He made workers of bones and weapons of weather. Break the circle and let us be dead.
quest.active_dialogue: Push through the Blackened Dynamo, defeat Vael Tormak, and recover the Thunderheart Aegis.
quest.completed_dialogue: The forge breathes clean thunder again. The Aegis recognizes you as bearer, not owner.
quest.description: Defeat Vael Tormak in the Hollow Thunderforge, end the forced labor of the dead, and claim the Thunderheart Aegis as a protective Thundervale relic.
quest.completion_text: Thundervale’s relic is secured, and the northward path toward Umbralwyrm Depths opens.

quest.name: Down the Blackfall
quest.offer_dialogue: Surface roads end here. If you insist on going down, learn how to fall without taking everyone’s light with you.
quest.active_dialogue: Reach the Outer Gate of Glowcap Commons and read the Compact’s laws before demanding entry.
quest.completed_dialogue: You arrive alive, which Shale considers a promising but incomplete credential.
quest.description: Survive the descent from Thundervale into the first underworld layer and reach the Compact’s outer gate.
quest.completion_text: You arrive alive, which Shale considers a promising but incomplete credential.

quest.name: No Flame Without Debt
quest.offer_dialogue: Bring back the stolen crystals. Then we can discuss whether your surface war deserves our air.
quest.active_dialogue: Trace the raiders through the Blindstone Warren and recover the stolen light from the quarry or hollow.
quest.completed_dialogue: Vessa grants the Glowcap Safe-Lantern and orders the gate opened to you.
quest.description: Recover stolen light-crystals to prove you understand that light is survival in the Depths, not decoration.
quest.completion_text: Vessa grants the Glowcap Safe-Lantern and orders the gate opened to you.

quest.name: The Price of Light
quest.offer_dialogue: You carry a lantern now. Learn what it costs before you spend it.
quest.active_dialogue: Speak with the lantern-keepers, healers, map sellers, and water-keepers of Glowcap Commons.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Compact accepts you as a dangerous guest rather than a dangerous stranger.
quest.description: Learn Glowcap Compact law by helping balance light, food, and water obligations inside the Commons.
quest.completion_text: The Compact accepts you as a dangerous guest rather than a dangerous stranger.

quest.name: The Compact’s Suspicion
quest.offer_dialogue: People with banners buy in daylight. People with plans buy in tunnels. Find which one came here.
quest.active_dialogue: Check the Ashen Exchange and follow the trail of stolen lantern oil and bone-lamp soot.
quest.completed_dialogue: Ikxit marks your lantern with a blue wick-knot, signaling that you are allowed to ask harder questions.
quest.description: Investigate whether surface factions, Cabal agents, or deep slavers are buying light and bone through the same channels.
quest.completion_text: Ikxit marks your lantern with a blue wick-knot, signaling that you are allowed to ask harder questions.

quest.name: The Cartographer Who Forgot Up
quest.offer_dialogue: I misplaced up. It is embarrassing professionally and dangerous personally.
quest.active_dialogue: Search the Cartographer’s Nook, Echo Crack, and Blackfall levels for the compass weights.
quest.completed_dialogue: Nimri sells you a corrected Bone-Map and admits that down is at least temporarily down again.
quest.description: Recover and reset Nimri’s bone compass so the lower roads can be mapped again.
quest.completion_text: Nimri sells you a corrected Bone-Map and admits that down is at least temporarily down again.

quest.name: Mushrooms for the Mourning
quest.offer_dialogue: Grief left raw becomes poison. Bring pale spores from the cleft, and we will make warning instead.
quest.active_dialogue: Collect grief-spores from the dangerous cleft beyond the farmlanes.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Choir turns grief into a map-warning and gives you a memory bead.
quest.description: Gather grief-spores so the Mycelial Choir can safely process the memories of the newly dead.
quest.completion_text: The Choir turns grief into a map-warning and gives you a memory bead.

quest.name: The Duergar Who Would Not Kneel
quest.offer_dialogue: Some will see my beard and hear slaver. Bring proof that I broke the chain instead of selling it.
quest.active_dialogue: Defeat chain-takers and recover a debt-token that points to Cabal buying agents.
quest.completed_dialogue: Borvak hammers the token flat and gives you a weapon meant for freeing, not owning.
quest.description: Help Borvak prove that free duergar are being hunted by Cabal-backed chain-takers.
quest.completion_text: Borvak hammers the token flat and gives you a weapon meant for freeing, not owning.

quest.name: The Last Surface Song
quest.offer_dialogue: My people remember morning as a song. The box that taught it is still in the old camp.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover the music box from the expedition camp near the Blackfall Ropewalk.
quest.completed_dialogue: Elian plays a cracked song of dawn, and for a moment the Depths feel less absolute.
quest.description: Recover the cracked music box from the collapsed expedition camp for the blind descendants who preserve sky-memory.
quest.completion_text: Elian plays a cracked song of dawn, and for a moment the Depths feel less absolute.

quest.name: The Water That Whispers Names
quest.offer_dialogue: Water should remember stone and thirst. It has begun remembering crowns. I dislike this.
quest.active_dialogue: Examine the basin, trace the black spores, and cleanse the cistern filter if needed.
