quest.completed_dialogue: Ayra confirms the dead-star disturbance reaches below the Marches through water as well as sky.
quest.description: Cleanse the basin and learn why underground water has begun speaking names from dead kingdoms.
quest.completion_text: Ayra confirms the dead-star disturbance reaches below the Marches through water as well as sky.

quest.name: The Ashen Exchange
quest.offer_dialogue: Someone is assembling a ritual from market scraps. I prefer my disasters itemized.
quest.active_dialogue: Question the Exchange, check the debt-token den, and follow the purchases toward the Wyrmglass Chasm.
quest.completed_dialogue: Tholm names the buyers as Crownless Cabal agents working for Sister Nhalira Voss.
quest.description: Investigate who is buying bone, shadow-crystal, dead maps, and silence in the Ashen Exchange.
quest.completion_text: Tholm names the buyers as Crownless Cabal agents working for Sister Nhalira Voss.

quest.name: Do Not Poison Water
quest.offer_dialogue: You can survive darkness. You cannot survive bad water. Help me prove that to the fools with bone-lamps.
quest.active_dialogue: Clean the cistern filter and defeat anything contaminating the water.
quest.completed_dialogue: Keth declares your hands clean enough to keep using the Commons’ cups.
quest.description: Protect the Blackwater Cistern and uphold one of the Compact’s most sacred laws.
quest.completion_text: Keth declares your hands clean enough to keep using the Commons’ cups.

quest.name: Iron Debts Below
quest.offer_dialogue: This token says three different people own the same crime. Bring me the truth or a better lie.
quest.active_dialogue: Recover a duergar debt-token and compare it against Ashen Exchange records.
quest.completed_dialogue: Orrix rules that the Cabal owns the crime and the Compact owns the grudge.
quest.description: Resolve a Compact debt tied to duergar refugees, Cabal buyers, and stolen chain marks.
quest.completion_text: Orrix rules that the Cabal owns the crime and the Compact owns the grudge.

quest.name: Maps Written in Spores
quest.offer_dialogue: Bone maps break where fear changed the stone. Spore maps remember fear.
quest.active_dialogue: Complete the Choir’s breathing circle and receive the dream-route.
quest.completed_dialogue: You wake with the Shadowed Ossuary written behind your eyes.
quest.description: Let the Mycelial Choir guide you toward the Shadowed Ossuary through fungal memory rather than ordinary maps.
quest.completion_text: You wake with the Shadowed Ossuary written behind your eyes.

quest.name: The Shattered Drow Observatory
quest.offer_dialogue: A sky below the earth is still a sky if one is desperate and precise enough.
quest.active_dialogue: Reach the inverted starwell and align the Wyrmglass Lens with the dead-star shadow.
quest.completed_dialogue: Seryne records the alignment and admits the surface omen has roots below.
quest.description: Use the inverted observatory to align the Wyrmglass Lens and locate the ossuary’s hidden approach.
quest.completion_text: Seryne records the alignment and admits the surface omen has roots below.

quest.name: Chains Beneath the Wyrm
quest.offer_dialogue: If the chain is real, cut it. If it cannot be cut, show me where to hit.
quest.active_dialogue: Study the Wyrmchain Cage and recover Nhalira’s chain-glyph.
quest.completed_dialogue: You understand the Wyrmchain well enough to make a final choice, though not safely.
quest.description: Discover the Cabal’s Wyrmchain and prepare to break or exploit it before facing the Umbralwyrm.
quest.completion_text: You understand the Wyrmchain well enough to make a final choice, though not safely.

quest.name: The Ossuary Sun-Mote
quest.offer_dialogue: The dark is not the enemy. The chain is. Carry this light carefully.
quest.active_dialogue: Use the Wyrmglass Lens to reach the Sun-Mote Chamber beneath the ossuary.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Sun-Mote warms your pack and makes every false shadow recoil.
quest.description: Recover the Sun-Mote, a buried light that can help sever the Umbralwyrm’s false chains.
quest.completion_text: The Sun-Mote warms your pack and makes every false shadow recoil.

quest.name: The Shadowed Ossuary
quest.offer_dialogue: The dragon may be a threat. The binder is certainly one. Remove the chain-maker first.
quest.active_dialogue: Push through the ossuary and defeat Sister Nhalira in her ritual circle.
quest.completed_dialogue: Nhalira falls, but her ritual leaves you with a harder choice than victory.
quest.description: Enter the Shadowed Ossuary, defeat Sister Nhalira Voss, and stop the Cabal from enslaving the Umbralwyrm.
quest.completion_text: Nhalira falls, but her ritual leaves you with a harder choice than victory.

quest.name: The Nightscale Bargain
quest.offer_dialogue: The Compact will witness. The Depths will remember. Choose carefully when the dragon asks what sort of power you carry.
quest.active_dialogue: Face Vorgul Nethra in the Wyrmheart Cavern and claim the Nightscale Lantern by the method you can live with.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Nightscale Lantern is yours, and the road to the Astral Crown Citadel is no longer hidden by ordinary darkness.
quest.description: Resolve the final encounter with Vorgul Nethra by fighting, bargaining, binding, or delaying the ancient Umbralwyrm.
quest.completion_text: The Nightscale Lantern is yours, and the road to the Astral Crown Citadel is no longer hidden by ordinary darkness.

quest.name: Final Stores for the Lost
quest.offer_dialogue: If we are walking into the end of a dead empire, we are doing it fed. Check the crate-market and infirmary before you charge off.
quest.active_dialogue: Visit the Refuge market and infirmary, then return to the war table when you understand what the outpost can provide.
quest.completed_dialogue: Liska presses a final supply cache into your hands and tells you not to waste it heroically.
quest.description: Help the Refuge organize final supplies before pushing into the Citadel proper.
quest.completion_text: The Refuge’s final stores are organized, and you have been supplied for the last push.

quest.name: Hold the Broken Chain
quest.offer_dialogue: They are testing the barricade again. Kill the warden they sent, and the Refuge becomes a base instead of a pause.
quest.active_dialogue: Push through the barricade and defeat the Warden of Broken Chains on the breach stair.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Refuge raises the Broken Chain Banner and holds long enough for the final advance.
quest.description: Defend the Refuge from the Cabal officer assigned to recapturing escaped prisoners.
quest.completion_text: The Refuge is defended, and every escaped prisoner in the Citadel knows the Cabal can bleed.

quest.name: The Seal of Survival
quest.offer_dialogue: Storm and tide know how to spare life when power would rather crush it. Wake both sockets.
quest.active_dialogue: Open the Seal Gate of Survival beyond the siege post.
quest.completed_dialogue: The entrance stabilizes. The Refuge will not be erased by the Citadel’s first breath.
quest.description: Use the Tidecrown Pearl and Thunderheart Aegis to stabilize the Citadel approach and keep the Refuge alive.
quest.completion_text: The Seal of Survival is open, and the road to the Concordance Halls is revealed.

quest.name: The Seal of Memory
quest.offer_dialogue: The Lich steals names because nameless people are easier to command. Make the old relics speak back.
quest.active_dialogue: Open the Seal Gate of Memory using seed, thorn, forge, and drowned band.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Archive of Stolen Names loses its claim. Memory becomes a weapon the Cabal cannot hold.
quest.description: Answer the Citadel’s stolen histories with the relics of Greenbarrow, Onfadell, Dawnhammer, and Hawga Daar.
quest.completion_text: The Seal of Memory is open, and the Starless Reliquary lies ahead.

quest.name: The Seal of Direction
quest.offer_dialogue: The Citadel is not lost. It is aiming. Help me make it miss.
quest.active_dialogue: Align mirage, tide, and storm at the Seal Gate of Direction.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Citadel loses its chosen landing path. The Marches are no longer the easiest wound in the world.
quest.description: Redirect the Astral Crown Citadel away from the Aurelian Marches before it fully materializes.
quest.completion_text: The Seal of Direction is open, and the inner Citadel is exposed.

quest.name: The Black-Star Door
quest.offer_dialogue: There is a darkness that hides monsters and a darkness that hides mercy. Your Lantern must know the difference.
quest.active_dialogue: Open the Black-Star Door beyond the Reliquary of Failed Crowns.
quest.completed_dialogue: The false dark peels away, and the last passage stands open.
quest.description: Use the Nightscale Lantern to reveal the true final passage after the relic gates are opened.
quest.completion_text: The Black-Star Door is open. Only the Crownless Throne remains.

quest.name: The Crownless Throne
quest.offer_dialogue: The Lich thinks a crown is proof. Show him it is a question.
quest.active_dialogue: Reach the Crownless Throne and resolve the final encounter by battle, united oath, control, or desperate collapse.
quest.completed_dialogue: The Crownless Lich is ended, bound, sealed, or broken enough for the living to decide the future.
quest.description: Face Azael Veyrath, the Crownless Lich, and decide what becomes of the Astral Crown.
quest.completion_text: The Astral Crown waits for a final choice.
quest.ending_text: The Crownless Lich is defeated, and the Astral Crown hangs silent above the surviving Marches. The Citadel no longer has one will forcing it into the world, but power remains, waiting for judgment.
quest.ending: The Marchwardens raise lanterns on every road that survived the dead star. They remember the victory as proof that roads exist to connect the living, not to carry armies to thrones.
The Silver Concord records the final battle in sealed silver script, then leaves one page blank for the choice no archive could make on your behalf.

choice.label: Seal the Crown Beyond the Stars

ending_choices.choice: You refuse both possession and destruction. The relics lift the Crown beyond mortal reach, where no Cabal, king, council, or hero can seize it without first answering the peoples it once endangered.

choice.label: Restore the Ward of the Marches

ending_choices.choice: You bind the relics into a renewed ward that does not erase borders or choices. The Marches remain divided, alive, argumentative, and protected by promises no one faction owns.
You claim the Crown and all its terrifying clarity. The Marches are safe, but every oath you make afterward carries the weight of a throne you swore would never rule without consent.

choice.label: Give the Crown to the Refuge

ending_choices.choice: You place the Crown under the custody of those the Cabal tried to erase. The Refuge of Broken Chains becomes a permanent watch, ruled by survivors who trust no crown and therefore guard this one best.

choice.label: Hide the Crown in Nightscale Shadow

ending_choices.choice: You call on the Nightscale Shadow and send the Crown beneath every map, into a darkness honest enough to admit it is dangerous. Vorgul Nethra’s debt becomes a watch rather than a weapon.

choice.label: Let your faction guide the future
